metadata.description: Hyperfocussed & obsessive utilities for the discerning dev goblin

plugins.name: goblin-scout
plugins.description: Scouted it, wrote it in the roadbook, lost the pencil. It keeps your plan as a map of what waits on what. Roadbooks as a dependency graph: JSON source of truth, mechanical status recompute, projected waypoint lists, Mermaid diagrams, an HTML chart, the interview, review and next-waypoint skills that drive it, and /scout-waypoints, a pane that shows the ready waypoints and starts a trail on one.

plugins.name: goblin-jester
plugins.description: hElLo. i aM tHe JeStEr. i WaTcH, i hEcKlE, i hOlD tHiNgS. i ToUcH nOtHiNg. A mod: goblin-mode's face inside Claude Code. A goblin in the band that reacts to the session, hint lines in its voice, a mask over every question, frames by model tier, a day cycle and the project theme's colours. Terminal only.

plugins.name: goblin-seneschal
plugins.description: Your grievance has been noted, my liege, and filed with the others. The underlings are mustered and the chambers stand inspected. Two mods: /log-grievance logs a grievance with Claude Code itself without a turn, context pre-filled; /muster-underlings shows every underling (Claude Code session) on the machine and sends one a line. Six skills: overhear-grievance, proclaim-releases, proclaim-changes, inspect-chambers, audit-prose and consult-dossiers.

plugins.name: goblin-warband
plugins.description: Coordinate several Claude Code sessions on one repository: a ledger of dibs on shared resources enforced by hooks, a /show-slate pane, tools that report, call dibs, grant and broadcast, a declaration that writes each raider's orders, and the protocol that came out of running it.

plugins.name: goblin-archivist
plugins.description: Goblin keeps everything. Goblin knows where everything is. Goblin has not decided yet whether to tell you. Connects Claude Code sessions on one Mac to one Obsidian vault. First slice: /goblin-archivist:sniff-vault surveys the vault read-only (layout, note types, properties, tags, templates, Tasks formats, plugins, published notes, Linter rules) and drafts a schema.
